1579 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, and not divisible by 100? Actually 1579 mod 4 = 3, so not leap year).  
32 weeks 5 days = 32*7 + 5 = 224 + 5 = 229 days.  
Subtract 229 days from 1579-03-02.  
March has 31 days, so back to 1579-02-??: From Mar 2 subtract 2 days → Feb 28 (since 1579 Feb has 28 days).  
Remaining days: 229 - 2 = 227 days earlier.  
Go into 1578: From Feb 28 back 28 days → Jan 31 (1579 Jan has 31 days). Remaining: 227 - 28 = 199 days earlier.  
From Jan 31 back 31 days → Dec 31, 1578. Remaining: 199 - 31 = 168 days earlier.  
From Dec 31, 1578 back 168 days:  
Dec: 31 days → back 31 → Nov 30, 1578 (remaining 168-31=137)  
Nov: 30 days → back 30 → Oct 31, 1578 (remaining 137-30=107)  
Oct: 31 days → back 31 → Sep 30, 1578 (remaining 107-31=76)  
Sep: 30 days → back 30 → Aug 31, 1578 (remaining 76-30=46)  
Aug: 31 days → back 31 → Jul 31, 1578 (remaining 46-31=15)  
Jul 31 back 15 days → Jul 16, 1578.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1578-07-16
